# Prerequisites

Please have the following ready before class:

- Have your OSCER credentials on hand
- Be able to access you OSCER account through Terminal or Mobaxterm
- Have lecture data copied over from Eleana's Scratch 

# Learning objectives

At the end of this lesson you will:

- Understand the steps in the Bulk RNA-seq pipeline up to the creation of a count matrix
- Be familiar with submitting SBATCH scripts to SLURM
- Have a better understanding of several bioinformatics file types
